verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a chronological Logs view with per-request detail pages (unique URLs) and manual feedback tagging, plus a broader observability claim of tracking 40+ metrics including cost and latency (docs-49, docs-50). However, no evidence explicitly shows the log entry UI displaying token counts, latency, and cost fields per request, so full request/response inspection with those attributes isn't directly documented. missing for 10: explicit doc/screenshot showing per-log latency, token count, and cost fields, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this UI.
